remarks: Welcome to this beautifully upgraded, turnkey home located at the end of Firenze Street in one of Laguna Niguel’s most desirable neighborhoods! Situated on a spacious, private lot with neighbors on only one side, this exceptional property offers a rare combination of privacy, an expansive wraparound backyard, and extensive interior and exterior improvements. The beautifully landscaped backyard features a generous grassy area, multiple mature fruit trees including lemon, lime, orange, and avocado, partial vinyl fencing, and newly installed backyard drains.
